# Tenkai

> Tenkai is for governed delivery to environments you do not fully control.

Customer-owned, disconnected, and regulated sites apply what they verify, not what a server tells them. Every change is signed and approved. The control plane is not trusted: a pull-only runtime checks the release and the approval before it applies, and a failed health probe rolls the site back.

## Core concepts

- A product has immutable signed releases. Promoting a release moves a channel to it.
- An environment subscribes to one channel per product and carries its own constraints, maintenance windows, and trust policy.
- A plan is a stored dry run. Apply executes it behind health probes. A failed probe restores the previous pin.
- Agents may create a plan. They must not approve or apply. A human signs the approval bound to that exact plan digest.

## Tasks

- [Governed deploy in 15 minutes](../README.md#governed-deploy-in-15-minutes): laptop lab via `tenkaictl quickstart`, then signed apply and rollback.
- [Deploy with approval](tasks/deploy-with-approval.md): plan, human-signed approval, apply.
- [Roll back](tasks/roll-back.md): restore the previously deployed version through a plan.
- [Find why a deploy is blocked](tasks/explain-blocked-deploy.md): status, explain, inspect.
- [Govern agent deployments](tasks/govern-agent-deployments.md): actor chain, budget, preview, approval brief.
- [Deliver to a disconnected site](tasks/disconnected-site.md): signed offline bundle, bind, receipt.

## Skill

- [tenkaictl skill](../.agents/skills/tenkai/SKILL.md): read status, propose plans, explain blockers, never approve.
